title: Color scheme AI Generate button: own line, ‘Let the AI Cook’, cooking animation

The first two are contained in origin/main; fd352c4 is not, so the latest text refinement is integrated locally but not shown as released. No matching task was found in the supplied task snapshot. Follow up only on the implementer's unanswered question about whether the separate ‘✦ AI Generate’ sidebar entry should also be renamed.
nextAction: Owner to decide whether to rename the ‘✦ AI Generate’ entry; if yes, assign the small UI follow-up to Product Development Lead. Confirm/publish fd352c4 if release of the final text styling is expected.
